title: I.C. Golaknath v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: I.C. Golaknath v. State of Punjab, AIR 1967 SC 1643
content.holding: An amendment under Article 368 is “law” under Article 13(2); Parliament has no power to abridge Fundamental Rights.
content.relevance: Prompted the 24th Amendment and the Kesavananda showdown.
